# Housekeeping: rack

## Authorized scope and smallest closable slice

Review the complete `crates/rack` Cargo package and its tests. Deliver practical, behavior-preserving cleanup in this package, or an evidenced no-change verdict when existing choices earn their cost. Cover all five user requests: repeated code/LoC; load-bearing test purposes; avoidable copies; applicable micro SIMD; and data structures that cap efficiency. The user requests two GPT-6.1 Sol xhigh agents concurrently; this overrides the default Terra implementation model for this workflow. Root Sol owns briefing, adversarial review, exact-path checkpoints, integration and remote synchronization.

## Frozen boundaries

Existing public APIs, feature behavior, canonical/wire identities, arithmetic order and per-lane rendered bits, latency/tail, link modes, smoothing and NaN/denormal rules remain contractual. Zero render allocations/frees, locks, I/O or syscalls; no runtime native ISA dispatch. Retain scalar tails, 4-lane Wasm/NEON and x86 AVX2/FMA. Preserve all feature and target configurations. Do not expand another open issue or change DSP algorithms. Read current related issue bodies before touching their subject; discoveries that require architecture or product decisions become bounded follow-ups and final owner questions.

## Implementation and test-value decisions

Prefer deleting or consolidating repetition to adding abstractions that increase total complexity. Assess every existing test or a clearly named homogeneous family by its plausible unique defect; remove trivial, redundant or obsolete cases only after identifying the surviving behavioral gate. Keep independent numeric/oracle, fault, allocation, queue, boundary and target tests. Add/rewrite tests only for a concrete uncovered defect, and state which plausible defect no existing test catches. No prose/source-grep tests, new bit-digest pins or exact resource-byte pins. Copies needed for ownership, snapshots or atomic admission stay unless the same semantics are proved with less work. Data structure changes must preserve deterministic order and bounded realtime work. Inspect applicable hot loops and generated code before claiming additional SIMD; recursive/stateful dependencies alone do not justify changing arithmetic.

## Objective gates and evidence

- Read all production and test files in this package; record concise findings for each of the five requests, concrete changed/deferred locations, and load-bearing test families with retained coverage for deletions.
- Run focused locked package tests and affected feature configurations; use existing downstream/RT/differential gates proportional to the changed contract. Check formatting and package clippy with warnings denied. Relevant Wasm and AArch64 compile checks are required for changed product code; record limitations candidly.
- Changes to DSP arithmetic or hot state need existing independent numeric and scalar/SIMD gates plus one-time base/head evidence when needed; no permanent comparison against the old implementation. Existing research remains the algorithm authority; no new algorithm or listening claim is authorized.
- Benchmarks are optional and descriptive. Any timed measurement freezes its workload/validator, passes zero-workload preflight, and runs exactly one invocation with one warmup/two measured rounds. No timing optimization loop, performance percentage or unsupported sound-quality claim.
- Root conducts one adversarial verdict per coherent attempt, at most five total attempts. Every new/rewritten test gets its unique-defect sentence in that verdict. No-change audits require the same five-axis review, not manufactured edits.
- Stop after a coherent compiling, focused-green tranche; root commits exact owned paths before further edits. Keep edits within `crates/rack` and this numbered spec. Independent crates use separate worktrees. Root pushes promptly and updates this GitHub issue with evidence; close only after PASS and evidence upstream, verifying remote state. Merge through the required qualification check and remove clean completed worktrees.

### Attempt 1 — final worker evidence

Root committed the single product path `crates/rack/src/lib.rs` as `1dbf9c51`, integrated/pushed as `a0ca8d7c` before this evidence append. Rust change: +24/−133, net **−109 lines**. No subsequent product edits, dependency changes, new tests or complete test deletions. Root adversarial verdict remains pending.

**Deletion survivors and rewritten-test value.** The prepared-slot runtime size ceiling duplicated its existing compile-time ceiling; mask conversion, spare caller capacity, nine-slot ordering and exactly-once stage destruction stay in `prepared_slot_activity_preserves_shape_bits_and_ownership`. Compact fixtures preserve all original lane bits and order, including high and holey masks; its independent one-/three-slot expected masks still catch bad packing and its nine slots catch slot truncation/reordering. The scratch tuple-size pin described private layout; `scratch_dimensions_match_the_bank_and_zero_quantum_is_refused` retains the actual dimension and typed-refusal claims, while existing downstream zero-allocation gates defend render ownership. The removed 512-vs-512 partition comparison was the oracle compared with itself; 1/7/64/128 partitions still compare with that retained 512-frame oracle. `has_active_lanes_scan` was private, test-only, allowed dead code and had no callers in any package/feature; its sole-writer counter consequently asserted an inevitable zero. Real query counts, two-block dispatch traces, faults and PCM remain in the prepared-activity tests. This is dead instrumentation deletion, with no runtime timing claim. `reference_dispatch` is only a rename/documentation clarification of the retained independent current planar algorithm, with no output pin.

The removed default fold revalidation is covered at admission by `fold_cohort_constructor_rejects_every_invalid_shape_without_writes` and at consumption by `default_and_override_fold_identical_complete_strided_cohorts`: physical IDs with holes, requested frames, extra capacity and untouched stride slack must agree for both widths. Constructor overflow and zero-frame refusals remain. The scratch fill removal relies on the public ownership proof recorded above; no feature or test-support consumer can obtain a used mutable `AoSoaScratch`. Existing partial/inactive-lane tests still defend zero padding and untouched lane output.

**All retained inline test families and their defects:**

- Prepared activity/identity dispatch: packed shape and ownership, independent planar drain/error/mono/seam traces, actual activity-query counts, and identity-slot call counters catch mask packing, reordered or skipped drain, premature PCM publication, extra dispatch and lost/double-owned processors. The reference follows current contracts independently of AoSoA dispatch.
- Direct plane views/scatter: four/eight width and capacity refusals, a per-lane fallback sentinel, wrong-width provider drop-before-fallback, and inadequate claimed capacity defend alias-view admission and complete staged recovery without out-of-range writes.
- Full/partial gather-scatter, tiled-vs-scalar transpose, frame-major layout and inactive lanes: hostile NaN payloads, signed zero, subnormals, infinities, ragged frames, an independent index-XOR stage and whole-block writes catch permutations, bit changes, bad tails, bad stage indexing and inactive-plane touches. Round trips alone cannot replace the index-law gates.
- Chain admission and scratch dimensions: wrong chain/slot mask lengths, empty activity, slot-to-chain lane implication and zero quantum catch malformed preparation before packed conversion.
- Stateful partition invariance: running sums across four distinct partitions catch lost state or sample reordering at block boundaries.
- Auxiliary destination/arming: default absence, accumulation while preserving the main plane, disarm and invalid masks catch replacing a second destination with the main destination or admitting unrenderable lanes.
- Prepared fold configuration/constructor/arming: mask validation, admitted PCM and disarm equivalence across the two current public preparation paths catch dropped preparation decisions or stale armed state.
- Fold and resident-cohort constructors/default-vs-override: every invalid shape, duplicate ID, short plane/stride and overflow, plus strided complete valid cohorts, catch admission holes and loss of physical IDs or spare-capacity preservation.
- Fold epilogue/full cohort/resident offer: folded lanes replace their own write, mixed lanes scatter, cohort callbacks retain physical order, and only fully folded full banks offer resident data before staging. Accepted and declined offers catch double writes and incomplete fallback.
- Resident output and RT9 acquisition: final planes after collapse, shape refusal, poisoned unused words, independent scalar gather, local width/quantum/activity declines and drain/error ordering catch wrong final-side reads or fallbacks that mutate unpublished data.
- Bank witness defaults/aggregation/publication: concrete overrides, width and inactive bounds, independent full/partial/identity terms and one publication after all drains catch false agreement or a proof made from stale control state.
- Collapse eligibility and disengagement: unarmed, ineligible, seam-only, incompatible suffix/prefix and partial-agreement cases stay dual; the independent seam arithmetic-order gate and exactly-once state copy catch changed bits and unsafe state transitions.
- `test-support` phase probes: direct/staged/fold/resident/aux scatter observations, disabled behavior and unchanged PCM catch misattributed paths or instrumentation that changes rendering. These are behavioral probes, not timing evidence.

**Integration families:** all eleven live-control cases stay. They separately defend lane queue isolation; boundary application/persistence; per-lane latency-preserving bypass; current wet state on unbypass; command partition invariance; lane/quantum bind refusal; unstable staging capacity refusal; absence of unrequested observation state; delayed dry history captured while wet; zero-latency current dry; and a channel-less bypass lane without an enormous staging window, with neighboring wet data/signed zero preserved. All four mono-reengagement cases stay: forced-off recovery renders never-collapsed bits; bypass can recover unchanged channel state; equal current words cannot prove separated recursive states agree; and an earned fixed-point proof can reengage when the coarse witness cannot. Their proof-query controls discriminate eligibility from coincidental PCM equality.

**SIMD and storage findings.** `objdump -d -C` of the optimized all-feature rack unit binary shows XMM four-wide and YMM eight-wide `vunpcklps`/`vunpckhps` transposes; the eight-wide paths use `vperm2f128`, and scatter contains scalar `vmovss` tails. The generated default fold callback has ordered lane dispatch and slice bounds checks, without the removed duplicate-ID/max/capacity scan. Existing register transposes already cover the full-bank movement; no additional micro SIMD is justified by this bounded audit. Partial-bank transpose work stays with #887, seam-copy fusion with #975, and collapse/input extensions with #974/#987. Packed activity bytes, bounded cohort IDs and preallocated plane/staging/window storage earn their cost. Control staging copies preserve disjoint per-lane admission windows; resident/staged fallbacks and seam/channel-state copies defend ownership and arithmetic order. No data-structure replacement, queue change, measured speedup or DSP change is claimed.

### Root adversarial verdict: PASS — attempt 1, 2026-10-01

Root independently reviewed the complete diff and public construction/mutation surfaces. For every admitted physical lane, the constructor's checked `(max_lane + 1) * stride` bound and `frames <= stride` imply the default fold's two slice bounds; immutable private dimensions/IDs cannot invalidate that proof. Public scratch starts zeroed and cannot be recovered after rendering, so its constructor's second fill is unnecessary. Per-lane dispatch/order and arithmetic, fallback, padding, live admission and ownership remain unchanged. Meaningful independent planar/scalar/staged/forced-dual references are retained; no historical-body deletion was inferred from a helper's old name. Reported target/RT/downstream gates cover this slice, with clippy configuration warnings and lack of device execution/timing disclosed.

Unique-defect verdicts for rewritten tests: `prepared_slot_activity_preserves_shape_bits_and_ownership` rejects packed-mask/slot-order errors and dropped or double-owned stage processors under malformed shapes and spare caller capacity; `prepared_slot_activity_preserves_dispatch_trace_and_errors` independently catches drain/process/error order across the directed planar scenarios; `prepared_slot_dispatch_uses_constant_activity_checks` retains the actual two-block call-count/trace gate that catches extra prepared-activity dispatch, while the deleted unused scan counter caught no reachable defect; `scratch_dimensions_match_the_bank_and_zero_quantum_is_refused` rejects a wrong plane extent or zero-quantum admission; `chain_run_is_partition_invariant` rejects lost recursive state or sample order across its retained four distinct partitions. These purposes remain in the same owning tests; no new test or private-layout pin is added.
